name: Back Up a SQLite Database
description: Make a consistent copy of a SQLite database with its built-in backup command on a schedule, which is safe to run while an application is using the database, unlike copying the file directly.

parameters.label: Database file path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the SQLite database file to back up. The sqlite3 command-line tool must be installed and on the PATH.

parameters.label: Backup file path
parameters.help: Absolute path of the backup file to write. It is overwritten on every run, so point it at a dated name or rotate it separately if you want history. Avoid spaces in both paths.
